paper_title: Tur[k]ingBench A Challenge Benchmark for Web Agents
caption: Distribution of errors in a single run of GPT4 across all tasks
model_annotation: The figure presents a pie chart illustrating the distribution of errors generated by GPT-4 across all tasks in a single run, categorized into several error types. The chart is divided into radial segments, each representing a different error category, with the size of each segment proportional to the percentage of errors belonging to that type. The segments are colored as follows: blue for "Incorrect" (43.6%), red for "Correct" (31.6%), green for "Partial" (11.3%), yellow for "Syntax Error" (2.3%), and a combination of purple/pink for "Unknown" (8.3%). Each segment is labeled with its corresponding percentage value located adjacent to the segment. The chart uses a circular layout, with the segments arranged clockwise around a central white space. A small red dot is positioned at the apex of the "Correct" segment.
